links.comparator_used: Manual contouring by radiation oncologists without AI template (randomized, with or without teaching)
links.outcome: Contour quality (DSC vs expert consensus) and contouring time for organs-at-risk in head-and-neck cases
links.effect: Without prior teaching, AI-assisted contouring raised DSC for optic nerve (0.05 [0.01; 0.10]), oral cavity (0.10 [0.06; 0.13]), parotid (0.07 [0.05; 0.12]), spinal cord (0.04 [0.01; 0.06]) and mandible (0.02 [0.01; 0.03]). Contouring time fell for brain stem (-1.41 [-2.44; -0.25]), mandible (-6.60 [-8.09; -3.35]), optic nerve (-0.19 [-0.47; -0.02]), parotid (-1.80 [-2.66; -0.32]) and thyroid (-1.03 [-2.18; -0.05]).
links.quote: AI-assisted contouring without previous teaching increased absolute DSC for optic nerve (by 0.05 [0.01; 0.10]), oral cavity (0.10 [0.06; 0.13]), parotid (0.07 [0.05; 0.12]), spinal cord (0.04 [0.01; 0.06]), and mandible (0.02 [0.01; 0.03]).

design_hint: e-learning / clinician training alongside AI assistance
